title: Flat roof, no railing
lines: Working on a flat roof with no railing?
Without fall protection, stay more than two meters from the edge.
The strip along the edge is marked in advance, with a warning sign.
The sign is in Hebrew and Arabic: "No entry, fall hazard".
Fragile or sloped roof? Stricter rules apply.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Safety first.
